purpose: Clinical research to improve prevention and health service planning.
question: For 2024, could you break down admissions whose principal diagnosis was COPD by the hospital where the stay took place? We want activity, so two admissions by one person count twice.
definitions: Exclude patients who opted out of reuse.
Use 31 December 2025 as the reference date; age is 2025 minus birth year.
Only inpatient stays starting in 2024; encounters.primary_icd10 begins J44.
Group by encounters.data_holder, not the patient’s home region or record holder; include all three hospitals.
